title: The WP Compress – Instant Performance & Speed Optimization plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Directory Traversal…
description: The WP Compress plugin for WordPress up to version 7.26.00 is vulnerable to a directory traversal flaw via the 'css' parameter. This vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary files on the server if the plugin's cookie-cache feature is enabled and a specific cookie is manipulated. Exploitation requires a preparatory request that injects a path traversal sequence into a tracked cookie, such as pll_language. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.9.
